enums.name: Status
enums.doc: The status of a call, with the code it has at the C boundary.

values.name: InvalidArg
values.doc: A value refused at construction, or a request that contradicts itself.

values.name: OutOfRange
values.doc: An instant or place outside the provider's or the calendar's coverage.

values.name: Capability
values.doc: The settings need something the provider does not declare.

values.name: Provider
values.doc: The provider failed; its own code and message are carried.

values.name: NotConverged
values.doc: A search hit its iteration cap.

values.name: Unsupported
values.doc: A registered but unimplemented variant, or an unknown key.

values.name: Pack
values.doc: A pack failed validation or targets another catalogue version.

values.name: Limit
values.doc: A batch, range or cache limit was exceeded.

values.name: SchemaVersion
values.doc: A struct or blob from an incompatible version.

values.name: Internal
values.doc: A panic caught at the boundary; never expected.

enums.name: Body
TimeScale

values.name: Ut1
values.doc: Universal Time (UT1), the scale of civil time and of rise and set.

values.name: Tt
values.doc: Terrestrial Time, the scale of the ephemerides.

enums.name: DistanceUnit
enums.doc: What a cell's distance is measured in.

values.name: MeanDistances
values.doc:
The body's mean distance, so 1 is the mean: a classical model,
whose hypotenuse is on the radius.

enums.name: SpeedModel
enums.doc: How a provider's speeds are defined.

values.name: Derivative
values.doc:
The rate of the position: a central difference over a short step
agrees with it, which the kit checks.

values.name: Rule
values.doc:
A text's rule for the daily motion, which its tradition uses as
the speed and which need not be the derivative of its places.

enums.name: Astronomy
enums.doc: Which astronomy a provider computes.

values.name: Modern
values.doc:
The sky as observed: an ephemeris, whose overrides the kit holds
to the SDK's IAU routines.

values.name: Classical
values.doc:
A classical text's model, whose obliquity, precession, daily
motions and sunrise are the text's own definitions; the kit
measures their distance from modern astronomy and publishes it
rather than gating it.

enums.name: Centre
enums.doc: Where a position is seen from.

values.name: Topocentric
values.doc: An observer on the Earth; the request carries the place.

enums.name: Equinox
enums.doc: The equinox and equator the coordinates refer to.

enums.name: Coordinates
enums.doc: The coordinate system of a position.

enums.name: ProviderCode

values.name: Unsupported
values.doc:
The operation, the frame or the option is not implemented by this
provider. A provider that cannot answer in the frame asked for
says so with this, and the SDK asks again in the provider's own
frame and completes the rest itself.

values.name: OutOfRange
values.doc: The instant is outside the provider's coverage.

values.name: DataMissing
values.doc: A data file the provider needs is missing.

values.name: Refused
values.doc: The provider refused rather than answer with something else.

enums.name: TsResolution
enums.doc: How a date was resolved (`docs/03-design/calendar-bikram-sambat.md`).

values.name: Defined
values.doc: A mathematical definition; exact by construction.

values.name: Computed
values.doc: Computed by the SDK's engine outside the table's range.

values.name: Divergent
values.doc:
Inside the range and the table and the engine disagree; the table
was followed and the engine's month and day are reported beside it.

enums.name: TsScale
enums.doc: A time scale of the conversions; the first two ids are the port's.

values.name: Utc
values.doc:
Coordinated Universal Time, through the leap-second table from
1972 and read as UT1 before it.

enums.name: TsZoneKind
enums.doc: What a zone specification names.

values.name: Iana
values.doc: A zone of the embedded database, by IANA name.

values.name: LocalMean
values.doc: Local mean time at a longitude.

enums.name: TsZoneSource
enums.doc: Where a resolution's offset came from.

values.name: LocalMean
values.doc: Local mean time from the longitude.

values.name: Manual
values.doc: A fixed offset the consumer stated.

enums.name: TsZoneEra
enums.doc: Which rules produced the offset.

values.name: Current
values.doc: An offset the zone applies in the database's own year.

values.name: Historical
values.doc: An offset from the zone's earlier rules.

values.name: BeforeRules
values.doc: Before the zone's first rule: the database's local-mean-time stub.

enums.name: TsDst
enums.doc: What the daylight-saving policy did.

values.name: Gap
values.doc: The civil time fell in a gap and was shifted forward past it.

values.name: Overlap
values.doc: The civil time fell in an overlap and one occurrence was chosen.

enums.name: TsChosen
enums.doc: Which occurrence an overlap resolved to.

values.name: Earlier
values.doc: The first occurrence, the earlier instant.

values.name: Later
values.doc: The second occurrence, the later instant.

enums.name: TsZoneWarning
enums.doc:
A warning of a resolution; `warnings` in the resolution is a bit set,
bit `n` for the warning with value `n`.

values.name: OffsetDiffersFromCurrentRules
values.doc: The offset is not one the zone applies today.

values.name: DstAmbiguous
values.doc: The civil time occurred twice; the policy chose.

values.name: DstGapShifted
values.doc: The civil time did not exist; the policy shifted it forward.

values.name: LeapSecondFolded
values.doc: A leap second (23:59:60) was folded onto the following midnight.

values.name: LeapTableExpired
values.doc: The instant lies beyond the leap-second table's word.

values.name: TimeUnknownFallback
values.doc: The time was not given; the policy supplied one.

enums.name: TsDeltaTSource
enums.doc: What produced a Delta T value.

values.name: Model
values.doc: From a model, outside the table.

values.name: LeapSeconds
values.doc: Through the leap-second table: TT less UTC, exact.

opaques.name: TsContext
opaques.doc:
An opaque context: settings, a provider, the locale engine, the last
error. Used by one thread at a time.

callbacks.name: CapabilitiesFn
callbacks.doc: Fills the capabilities; returns `0` or a `ProviderError::code`.

callbacks.name: PositionsFn
callbacks.doc: Fills the columns for a request; returns `0` or a `ProviderError::code`.

callbacks.name: ObliquityFn
callbacks.doc:
The obliquity override: the mean and true obliquity and the nutation
at an instant on a time scale (`TimeScale::id`).

callbacks.name: DeltaTFn
callbacks.doc: The Delta T override: TT less UT1 in seconds at a UT1 instant.

callbacks.name: AyanamshaFn
callbacks.doc:
The ayanamsha override: the mean ayanamsha in degrees at an instant,
by catalogue id.

callbacks.name: Dut1Fn
callbacks.doc: The DUT1 override: UT1 less UTC in seconds at a UTC instant.

callbacks.name: HorizonEventFn
callbacks.doc:
The rise and set override: writes the instant and whether the event
was found inside the window.

callbacks.name: CrossingsFn
callbacks.doc:
The crossings override: writes up to `capacity` events into the
caller's buffer and the number found into `out_count`, which may exceed
the capacity, in which case the caller calls again with a larger buffer.

structs.name: ObserverC
structs.doc:
A C observer: degrees and metres, validated into a `Place` on the
way in.

structs.name: PositionRequestC
structs.doc: A C position request over a grid.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: The scale the instants are on.

fields.name: frame_bits
fields.doc:
The frame the positions are wanted in, packed; `ts_frame_pack`
builds it from a frame's fields and `ts_frame_unpack` reads it back.

fields.name: observer
fields.doc: The observer, which a topocentric frame needs.

fields.name: jds
fields.doc: The instants, on the request's scale.

structs.name: PositionColumnsC
structs.doc:
C columns the provider fills: caller-owned arrays of `capacity` cells,
instants outermost.

fields.name: frame_bits
fields.doc: Written by the provider: `Frame::to_bits` of the values.

fields.name: capacity
fields.doc: The number of cells each array holds.

structs.name: ObliquityC
structs.doc: A C obliquity.

structs.name: HorizonRequestC
structs.doc: A C horizon-event request.

fields.name: window_days
fields.doc: The search ends this many days later.

fields.name: altitude_deg
fields.doc: The altitude of the disc point at the event, degrees.

structs.name: CrossingRequestC
structs.doc: A C crossings request.

fields.name: quantity_kind
fields.doc: `Quantity::kind_id`: 0 a longitude, 1 a speed, 2 a composite.

fields.name: second_body
fields.doc: `Body::id` of the second body of a composite; else zero.

fields.name: coefficient_a
fields.doc: The first body's coefficient in a composite.

fields.name: coefficient_b
fields.doc: The second body's coefficient in a composite.

fields.name: step_deg
fields.doc: The lattice's spacing, degrees; zero for a single target.

fields.name: tolerance_days
fields.doc: How closely each instant is placed, days.

fields.name: observer
fields.doc: The observer, read when `has_observer` is set.

structs.name: CrossingEventC
structs.doc: A C crossing event.

structs.name: DataHashC
structs.doc: A C data hash.

structs.name: CapabilitiesC
structs.doc:
C capabilities; every pointer is owned by the provider and valid for
its lifetime.

fields.name: deterministic
fields.doc: Whether identical requests give identical bits.

fields.name: tier
fields.doc: The tier plus one, zero for none (`Source::to_bits` encoding).

fields.name: ayanamshas
fields.doc: The ayanamshas the override knows, as catalogue ids.

structs.name: ProviderVtable
structs.doc:
The vtable: `user_data` is whatever the provider registered and is
passed back to every function; a null function is an undeclared
operation.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.doc: The capabilities; must not be null.

fields.name: positions
fields.doc: The positions; must not be null.

fields.name: ayanamsha
fields.doc: The ayanamsha override, degrees, by catalogue id.

structs.name: TsString
structs.doc:
A string the library allocated: UTF-8, NUL-terminated at `datalen`,
`len` bytes before the NUL, freed by `ts_string_free`.

fields.name: len
fields.doc: The number of bytes before the NUL.

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: The allocation's capacity, needed to free it.

structs.name: TsStr
structs.doc:
A string the library lends: UTF-8, NUL-terminated, `len` bytes before
the NUL, valid until the next call on the same context.

fields.name: data
fields.doc: The bytes; never null once written.

fields.name: len
fields.doc: The number of bytes before the NUL.

structs.name: TsHash
structs.doc:
A SHA-256 as thirty-two bytes; every hash the SDK reports in
provenance is one, rendered as sixty-four hex digits in JSON.

structs.name: TsBlob
structs.doc:
A result blob the library allocated; its layout is the `TSRB` encoding
under the schema the entry point names, both in `idl/api.json`.

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: The allocation's capacity, needed to free it.

structs.name: TsContextOptions
structs.doc:
How a context is built. Every field may be left at its zero value: a
null `profile` selects `ts_default_profile`, a null `settings_json`
patches nothing, a null `locale` renders in the base locale.

fields.name: settings_json
fields.doc:
A JSON settings patch over the profile: an object whose groups and
knobs are the settings document's, every one optional; an unknown
knob or a value outside its type is `INVALID_ARG` naming it.

fields.name: locale
fields.doc: The locale every render resolves from (`ne-Deva-NP`).

structs.name: TsError
structs.doc:
The last error of a call on a context: the status, the detail, and the
message, field, hint and message key as strings the context lends
until its next call; an `OK` record has empty strings.

fields.name: provider_code
fields.doc: The provider's own code when the status is `PROVIDER`, else zero.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: The English message naming the field and the range.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc: A hint (`did you mean ...`), or null.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The localisable message key, or null.

structs.name: TsFrame
structs.doc:
A frame by name: what a position is seen from, in which equinox and
coordinates, in which zodiac, with which corrections applied.

fields.name: ayanamsha
fields.doc:
The ayanamsha, read only when `sidereal` is set; `0xFFFF` names
none, which is what a tropical frame carries.

fields.name: centre
fields.doc:
Where the position is seen from; a topocentric frame needs the
request's observer.

fields.name: equinox
fields.doc: Which equinox the coordinates refer to.

fields.name: sidereal
fields.doc: The sidereal zodiac, which uses `ayanamsha`; tropical otherwise.

structs.name: TsCalendarDate
structs.doc:
A date in a calendar. Years are astronomical (1 BCE is 0); the era view
is presentation only and is filled by the library, ignored on input.

fields.name: era
fields.doc:
The era the calendar attaches, `0xFFFF` for none; filled by the
library and ignored on input.

fields.name: era_year
fields.doc: The year in the era, 1-based; meaningful when `era` is set.

fields.name: month
fields.doc: The month, 1-based; for the ISO week date, the week.

fields.name: day
fields.doc: The day, 1-based; for the ISO week date, the weekday 1 to 7.

fields.name: computed_month
fields.doc: The engine's month when the resolution is divergent, else zero.

fields.name: computed_day
fields.doc: The engine's day when the resolution is divergent, else zero.

structs.name: TsCivilTime
structs.doc: A time of day, or none when the birth time is unknown.

fields.name: second
fields.doc: The second; `60` only for a leap second the table has.

fields.name: has_time
fields.doc:
Whether the time is given; a date-only civil time has none, and the
context's unknown-time policy decides what to do.

structs.name: TsCivilDateTime
structs.doc: A civil date and time in a calendar.

structs.name: TsZoneSpec
structs.doc: A zone: an IANA name, a fixed offset, or local mean time at a longitude.

fields.name: offset_seconds
fields.doc: The offset east of UTC in seconds, for a fixed offset.

fields.name: longitude_deg
fields.doc: The longitude east-positive in degrees, for local mean time.

fields.name: zone
fields.doc: The IANA name, for a database zone.

structs.name: TsZoneResolution
structs.doc:
What a resolution applied, enough to reproduce it after the zone
database changes.

fields.name: offset_seconds
fields.doc: The offset east of UTC applied, seconds.

fields.name: dst_shift_seconds
fields.doc: How far a civil time inside a gap was shifted forward, seconds.

fields.name: warnings
fields.doc: What the resolution wants the consumer to know.

fields.name: tzdb_version
fields.doc:
The zone database version (`2026c`), `manual` or `lmt`; lent until
the next call on the context.

fields.name: abbreviation
fields.doc:
The zone's abbreviation at the instant (`NPT`), or null; lent until
the next call on the context.

fields.name: chosen
fields.doc:
Which occurrence an overlap resolved to; meaningful when `dst` is
an overlap.

fields.name: time_known
fields.doc: Whether the time was given rather than supplied by a policy.

structs.name: TsTimeConversion
structs.doc: A conversion between time scales with what it applied.

fields.name: delta_t_source
fields.doc: What produced the Delta T applied.

fields.name: proleptic_utc
fields.doc: Whether UTC before 1972 was read as UT1.

fields.name: jd
fields.doc: The instant on the target scale.

fields.name: delta_t_seconds
fields.doc: The Delta T applied, seconds; zero for a conversion that needs none.

fields.name: uncertainty_seconds
fields.doc: Delta T's one-sigma uncertainty, seconds, when `has_uncertainty`.

fields.name: dut1_seconds
fields.doc:
UT1 less UTC applied, seconds: zero until a provider supplies the
IERS bulletins.

fields.name: delta_t_model
fields.doc:
The Delta T model's key (`TABLE_THEN_MODEL`); lent until the next
call on the context.

structs.name: TsDeltaT
structs.doc: Delta T at an instant with what produced it.

fields.name: model
fields.doc: The model's key; lent until the next call on the context.

structs.name: TsIntlLoaded
structs.doc: What a loaded pack or bundle carried.

fields.name: replaced
fields.doc: The entries that replaced ones already loaded.

fields.name: locale
fields.doc: The locale; lent until the next call on the context.

fields.name: sha256
fields.doc:
The file's SHA-256 as sixty-four hex digits; lent until the next
call on the context.

functions.name: ts_abi_version
functions.doc: The ABI version this library implements.

functions.name: ts_sdk_version
functions.doc: The SDK version as a static NUL-terminated string (`0.0.0`).

functions.name: ts_catalogue_version
functions.doc: The catalogue schema version every result's provenance stamps.

functions.name: ts_default_profile
functions.doc:
The profile a context uses when its options name none, as a static
NUL-terminated string.

functions.name: ts_build_info
functions.doc:
What this build is, as a static NUL-terminated JSON object: the SDK
version, the ABI and catalogue versions, the commit and whether its
tree was clean, the profile, the target, whether debug assertions and
optimisation are on, the sanitizer if any, and the compiler.

A binding reads it when it loads the library and refuses one that is
not the build its own half was generated for
(`02-architecture/07-binding-architecture.md`, "Loading and
identity"). The document is written when the library is compiled, so
it costs nothing to ask and cannot disagree with the library it
describes.

functions.name: ts_status_message
functions.doc:
A static NUL-terminated English phrase for a status code; `unknown
status` for a code this build does not know.

functions.name: ts_string_free
functions.doc:
Frees a string the library allocated and zeroes the descriptor; null
or an empty string is ignored.
functions.safety:
`string` must be null or a descriptor written by this library that is
not used again.

functions.name: ts_blob_free
functions.doc:
Frees a blob the library allocated and zeroes the descriptor; null or
an empty blob is ignored.
functions.safety:
`blob` must be null or a descriptor written by this library that is not
used again.

functions.name: ts_context_new
functions.doc:
Creates a context. `options` may be null for every default; `provider`
may be null, in which case the `TS_CONTEXT_TEST_PROVIDER` flag selects
the analytic test provider and no flag leaves the context without an
ephemeris (positions are then `CAPABILITY`); `provider_user_data` is
passed back to the vtable's functions untouched and must stay valid
until `ts_context_free`. On success `*out_context` owns the context;
on failure, when `out_error` is not null, it receives the error's
message as a string to free with `ts_string_free`.
functions.safety:
Every pointer must be null or valid for the access its documentation
describes, for the duration of the call; a vtable's functions must be
callable with `provider_user_data` until the context is freed.

functions.name: ts_context_free
functions.doc: Frees a context; null is ignored.
functions.safety:
`context` must be null or a handle from `ts_context_new` that is not
used again.

functions.name: ts_context_last_error
functions.doc:
The outcome of the last call on the context: its status, the provider's
code, and the message, field, hint and key as strings lent until the
next call other than this one. After a successful call the record is
`OK` with a null message.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `out_error` valid for a read of its
`struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_context_profile
functions.doc:
The id of the profile the context's settings came from, lent until the
next call on the context.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_profile` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_context_settings_json
functions.doc:
The resolved settings as their canonical JSON document, allocated for
the caller; free it with `ts_string_free`. Two contexts with the same
document compute the same numbers.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_json` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_context_settings_hash
functions.doc:
The SHA-256 of the canonical settings document: the `settings_hash`
every result's provenance carries.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_hash` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_key_parse
functions.doc:
Resolves a full key (`graha.SUN`, an alias, or a former key) to its
packed id. An unknown key is `UNSUPPORTED` with the nearest known key as
the hint in the context's last error.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `key` a NUL-terminated string; `out_id`
valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_key_name
functions.doc:
The full key of a packed id (`graha.SUN`), lent until the next call on
the context. An id no catalogued member has is `UNSUPPORTED`.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_key` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_frame_canonical
functions.doc:
Writes the SDK's canonical frame: apparent geocentric ecliptic of date,
tropical, which both licensed engines return by default and every chart
module consumes. Set `struct_size` before the call.
functions.safety: `out_frame` must be valid for a read of its `struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_frame_pack
functions.doc: Packs a frame into the bits a position request carries.
functions.safety:
`frame` must be valid for a read of its `struct_size`; `out_bits` for a
write.

functions.name: ts_frame_unpack
functions.doc:
Reads packed frame bits back into their fields; bits no frame sets are
`INVALID_ARG`.
functions.safety: `out_frame` must be valid for a read of its `struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_from_fixed
functions.doc: The date a fixed day falls on in a calendar.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `out_date` valid for a read of its
`struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_to_fixed
functions.doc:
The fixed day of a date, validated: a date the calendar does not have
is `INVALID_ARG` with the `NONEXISTENT_DATE` detail.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `date` valid for a read; `out_fixed`
valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_convert
functions.doc: Converts a date into another calendar.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `date` valid for a read; `out_date`
valid for a read of its `struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_month_length
functions.doc: The length of a month in a calendar.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_length` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_is_leap
functions.doc: Whether a year is a leap year in a calendar: `1` or `0`.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_leap` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_weekday
functions.doc: The weekday of a date as its ISO number: Monday is `1`, Sunday `7`.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `date` valid for a read; `out_weekday`
valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_calendar_jd_of_fixed
functions.doc:
The Julian day at the UTC midnight that begins a fixed day (fixed day
1 is Monday, 1 January 1 CE; the relation is `fixed + 1721424.5`).

functions.name: ts_calendar_fixed_of_jd
functions.doc:
The fixed day a Julian day falls in, and, when `out_fraction` is not
null, the fraction of that day elapsed since its midnight.
functions.safety: `out_fraction` must be null or valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_time_resolve
functions.doc:
Resolves a civil date-time in a zone to a UTC instant under the
context's daylight-saving and unknown-time policies, with the metadata
a stored chart keeps. An unknown zone is `UNSUPPORTED` with the nearest
names as the hint; a civil time inside a gap under the `error` policy
is `INVALID_ARG` with the `DST_GAP` detail.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `civil` and `zone` valid for reads;
`out_resolution` valid for a read of its `struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_time_civil
functions.doc:
The civil date-time of a UTC instant in a zone, in a calendar, with
the resolution that applied.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `zone` valid for a read; `out_civil`
and `out_resolution` valid for reads of their `struct_size` and writes.

functions.name: ts_time_convert
functions.doc:
Converts an instant between UT1, TT and UTC under the context's Delta T
model, reporting what was applied. A model that cannot answer for the
instant is `OUT_OF_RANGE`.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `out_conversion` valid for a read of
its `struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_time_delta_t
functions.doc:
Delta T (TT less UT1) at a UT1 instant under the context's model, with
what produced it and its uncertainty where the source has one.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `out_delta_t` valid for a read of its
`struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_intl_load_pack
functions.doc:
Loads a `.tpack` or `.tbundle` file: a locale it brings is added, a
namespace it brings replaces what was loaded under the same keys. A
file that does not verify is `PACK`.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `bytes` valid for `bytes_len` reads;
`out_loaded` valid for a read of its `struct_size` and a write.

functions.name: ts_intl_set_locale
functions.doc:
Selects the locale every render resolves from; an unknown one is
`UNSUPPORTED` naming the loaded locales.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `locale` a NUL-terminated string.

functions.name: ts_intl_locale
functions.doc:
The locale every render resolves from, lent until the next call on the
context.
functions.safety: `context` must be a live handle; `out_locale` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_intl_has
functions.doc: Whether the current locale or its fallbacks have a message: `1` or `0`.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `key` a NUL-terminated string;
`out_has` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_intl_transliterate
functions.doc:
Text from one script into another (`deva`, `iast`), as a string lent
until the next call on the context. A pair the build has no table for
is `UNSUPPORTED` naming both scripts; anything the table does not know
passes through, so a name written in two scripts is transliterated in
the half that needs it.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `text`, `from` and `to`
NUL-terminated strings; `out_text` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_intl_entity
functions.doc:
An entity's forms in the current locale or its fallbacks, as a JSON
object lent until the next call on the context: every form the locale
gives (`name`, `prose`, `iast`, `short`, and any it adds), the
`glyph` when it has one, and the `gender` when the locale marks one.
A key the locale chain does not carry is `UNSUPPORTED`, naming the
locale that was asked.

The typed accessors each binding generates read entities through this,
so an application spells `graha.SUN` once and never a name.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `key` a NUL-terminated string;
`out_json` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_intl_render
functions.doc:
Renders a message with parameters given as a JSON object: a string, an
integer, a number or an array is itself; an entity is
`{"$entity": "graha.SUN"}`; a date `{"$date": {"calendar": "GREGORIAN",
"year": 2026, "month": 9, "day": 6}}`; a time `{"$time": {"hour": 6,
"minute": 15, "second": 0}}`; a date and time `{"$datetime": {"date":
{...}, "time": {...}}}`; a ghati count `{"$ghati": {"ghati": 12,
"pala": 30, "vipala": 0}}`. A null `params_json` renders with none.
The result blob carries the text, where it resolved from and the
warnings; a missing message renders as its key with a warning, never
an error.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `key` a NUL-terminated string;
`params_json` null or one; `out_blob` valid for a write.

functions.name: ts_positions
functions.doc:
Positions over a grid of instants and bodies in the requested frame:
the provider answers in the frame it can, the SDK completes the rest
under the profile's override policy, and every step is stamped. A
context without an ephemeris is `CAPABILITY`; a provider failure is
`PROVIDER` with the provider's own code in the last error.
functions.safety:
`context` must be a live handle; `request` valid for a read, with its
instants and body ids valid for the counts it states; `out_blob` valid
for a write.

blobs.name: positions
blobs.doc: Positions over a grid of instants and bodies, instants outermost: cell `i * body_count + j` is instant `i`, body `j`.

sections.name: summary
sections.doc: The grid and the frame the values are in.

fields.name: frame_bits
fields.doc: The frame the values are in, packed as the port packs it.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: The time scale of the instants.

sections.name: instants
sections.doc: The instants of the request, in order.

fields.name: jd
fields.doc: A Julian day on the request's scale.

sections.name: bodies
sections.doc: The bodies of the request, in order.

sections.name: cells
sections.doc: One row per cell, instants outermost; a cell whose status is not zero carries no value.

fields.name: lon_speed
fields.doc: Longitude speed in degrees per day; zero when speeds were not asked for.

fields.name: lat_speed
fields.doc: Latitude speed in degrees per day.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: The cell's status code; zero is a value.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: What computed the cell, packed as the port packs it.

sections.name: steps
sections.doc: UTF-8 JSON: the completion steps applied, in order, each `{"name", "implementation"}`.

sections.name: provenance
sections.doc: UTF-8 JSON: the provenance envelope of the result, canonical.

fields.name: is_fallback
fields.doc: Non-zero when a fallback locale answered.

fields.name: is_override
fields.doc: Non-zero when a runtime override answered.

sections.name: text
sections.doc: UTF-8: the plain text, markup stripped.

sections.name: resolved_from
sections.doc: UTF-8: the locale whose message answered; empty when none had it.

sections.name: warnings
sections.doc: UTF-8 JSON: an array of strings, one per problem met.
